assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate, raising clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered for continuous rhythm monitoring to accurately capture the arrhythmia during symptomatic events and guide further management.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure requires advance approval.
The missing precertification is the basis for denial code CO-197.
The service directly addresses the documented indication of recurrent palpitations and suspected SVT.
